units.rawText: Ah... you found me, Professor. This is my secret base. I can look down on the entire Oasis from here and even see other sectors in the distance.

units.rawText: Also, high places are close to the sun, so my flame can burn brighter. Now, this place that nobody else knows about will be a secret for the two of us. Yup, just the two of us.
